research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cytonus Therapeutics is developing systems and methods for manufacturing therapeutic cells, including obtaining enucleated cells from nucleated cells and processing them for use in cellular therapeutic platforms. Their research includes compositions and methods for treating cancer by administering enucleated cells containing exogenous mRNA encoding cytokine polypeptides, rapid vaccine platforms using enucleated cell-based delivery, and delivery of single-domain antibodies for therapeutic purposes. These areas define their research and development focus.

overview_description.description: Axiom Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing regenerative therapies and targeted biologics. It develops cell therapy programs using cellular engineering to address neurological, inflammatory, and regenerative medicine conditions. The company also uses AI-enabled drug design and targeted delivery technologies to support the development of therapeutic candidates.
